local_checks.result: before any download, the step refuses: plugins/omp-gateway absent or not a directory (update-agent-assets.sh:2032-2035); profiles/thak/node_modules a symlink or not a directory (2036-2039); node_modules/dsh-omp-gateway anything but absent or a symlink (2040-2043), since ln -sfn onto a real directory would make a link inside it. dsh_link_plugin (1971-1977) then runs `mkdir -p` on node_modules and `ln -sfn ../../../plugins/omp-gateway` at the fixed link path; -n replaces a symlink of any target without following it, so every run converges on the same relative link (target DSH_HOME/plugins/omp-gateway). It runs on the fresh install after the profile's pnpm install (2211), on the repair path (2214) and on the already-installed exit before the receipt is read (2125); each failure returns 1 naming the state left.
